# Psalms

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Psalms is the Bible's hymnbook, expressing worship, lament, thanksgiving, repentance, and praise. The book teaches that every human experience can be brought honestly before God in faith.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Psalm 1:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Blessed is the man</div>

### Why This Verse

Opening wisdom psalm

### Chapter Insight

This psalm contrasts the way of the righteous and the wicked. The key verse emphasizes that true blessing comes from delighting in God's Word.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Psalm 2:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou art My Son</div>

### Why This Verse

Major messianic text quoted in the NT

### Chapter Insight

This psalm proclaims God's sovereignty over earthly rulers. The key verse points to the Messiah's ultimate reign.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Psalm 3:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou, O LORD, art a shield for me</div>

### Why This Verse

Classic trust verse

### Chapter Insight

This psalm expresses David's trust in God during adversity. The key verse emphasizes God as protector and sustainer.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
